description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Remitly is hiring a Fullstack Software Development Engineer I for its Lending Servicing team. The role builds and scales full-stack systems for borrowing products, from origination through servicing and repayment, and collaborates with product managers, data scientists, and engineers on customer-focused software solutions.
Fullstack Software Development Engineer I implementing lending software and contributing to technical design with React, GraphQL, and Java/Kotlin

Responsibilities:
• Build for scale : Design and implement solutions for ambiguous and complex problems using full stack technologies (React, GraphQL, Java/Kotlin) that operate at scale
• Design: Participate in the brainstorming, technical design, and grooming of the next generation of Lending with a data-driven and customer-centric viewpoint
• Craft with pride: Focus on overall product quality and build
• Collaborate: You will work with product managers, data scientists and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into scalable, high-quality software solutions

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
• 1+ years of professional software development experience, with experience building and operating systems end-to-end
• Proficiency in TypeScript/React (or similar) plus a backend language (Node.js, Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python)
• Use AI tools in your own workflow, from authoring agents to drafting technical specs and prototypes
• Experience with distributed, large-scale systems and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred:
• Experience in FinTech, lending, or payments
